# Longbridge Value Investing

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. A stock can screen cheap for years because the business is deteriorating; value methods manage that risk, they do not remove it. Curated by Skill Harbor: the value investing skill of the Longbridge platform, published by the broker itself. It runs both classic schools over Longbridge statement data, with a cross-statement reconciliation pass before any scoring. On the Graham side: a single-stock diagnostic with a 100-point static score across net current asset value, PE, PB, dividends, debt coverage and earnings stability, adjusted dynamically for industry cycle, insider activity and the NCAV trajectory; and a batch screener that applies net-net and defensive-investor filters across an index or market universe and returns a ranked candidate list with a Graham buy price and explicit value-trap warnings. On the Buffett side: a moat analyzer that grades five dimensions (business and moat, financial health, management, valuation, long-term visibility) into a star-rated card with a narrative read; and a quality-compounder screener that first applies hard quantitative filters (ROE at or above 15 percent, debt at or below 50 percent, positive free cash flow, gross margin at or above 30 percent), then scores the moat qualitatively and returns three to five candidate cards.
